g.text: Apply shared saved-outcome rules (diagram index / FC-07).
Resolve accessible success before new-generation checks:
no generation or extra usage, even at 20 used or during outage.
Permissions, privacy, deletion/expiry and current catalog apply.
Resolve request under FC-07 shared saved-outcome rules
Accessible saved proposal or successful new generation?
Use saved or new proposal; no automatic activation
Preview ordered courses and reasons for explicit acceptance
This roadmap already active for this Student?
Return current plan; do not repeat replacement
An archived unstarted course prevents acceptance.
Require eligible proposal and another preview/acceptance
Proposal still accessible and eligible at acceptance?
Keep current plan; require fresh preview
Make this the one active roadmap
Keep current active plan, if any
Explain catalog gap; keep current plan
Explain unmet condition; preserve current plan
Show no active roadmap and offer a new request
Show completed included courses / total courses
Roadmap progress displays 100% only when every
Show Completed; no separate roadmap badge
Any archived course not yet started?
Show course unavailable without marking it complete
Offer a replacement request; never replace silently
Weekly hours and all unfinished-course estimates supplied?
Show approximate duration using full estimates
